It could be 1 of 2 things from the information that you provided.
1) Check your Ferts and see if any of them contain copper. Snails are more sensitive to copper than shrimp.
2) Do a couple more water changes. The salt that you put into the take may still be present and snails are very sensitive to salt.

What does /v/books think about the use of symbolism in books?

For me personally, the book where I saw symbolism best employed in was The Great Gatsby. It was symbolic on so many levels, from the subtleties of color and place names to the blatant eyes of Dr TJ Metaphor. I felt that this web of symbolism added a lot of depth to the novel, without which the novel would have felt a lot more shallow. The symbols utilized really helped to bring out the themes that Fitzgerald was trying to show.
